name: Steirereck im Stadtpark

name: Amador

name: Konstantin Filippou

name: Mraz & Sohn

what_to_order: Kimchi börek · 13 small courses · Chef's table

name: Doubek
recognition: MICHELIN 2026 two stars; Gault&Millau 2027 four Hauben, 18.5/20
what_to_order: French duck · Four fire sources · Small sweets
notes: MICHELIN Guide Austria 2026 starred list (ceremony 18 March 2026) and Gault&Millau 2027 Vienna list (page updated 20 Oct 2026); MICHELIN venue page
verdict: A fire-and-koji room for cooks who like technique they can see.
caveat: Open Wednesday to Saturday dinner only.

name: Addiert
recognition: MICHELIN 2026 one star (new); Gault&Millau 2027 four Hauben, 17/20
what_to_order: Gochujang ceviche · Nine-course Korean menu · Counter dining
notes: MICHELIN Guide Austria 2026 starred list (ceremony 18 March 2026) and Gault&Millau 2027 Vienna list (page updated 20 Oct 2026); MICHELIN venue page

name: JOLA
recognition: MICHELIN 2026 one star (new); Gault&Millau 2027 four Hauben, 17/20
what_to_order: Raviolo · Surprise set menu · Alcohol-free pairing
notes: MICHELIN Guide Austria 2026 starred list (ceremony 18 March 2026) and Gault&Millau 2027 Vienna list (page updated 20 Oct 2026); MICHELIN venue page
verdict: Proof that a one-star vegan menu can be cooked with real technique.
caveat: Closed Monday, Tuesday and Sunday.

name: Glasswing
neighborhood: Kärntner Ring 8, in The Amauris hotel
what_to_order: Tortelloni with Swiss chard · Sea urchin bisque · Hoshigaki and XO sauce · Celery with dulce de leche, coffee and pickled quince
notes: Own site and MICHELIN page; MICHELIN Guide Austria 2026 starred list
verdict: Classic French technique with sea urchin and XO on a Ring address.
caveat: Closed Sunday and Monday; own site lists no prices.

name: Pramerl & the Wolf
recognition: MICHELIN 2026 one star; Gault&Millau 2027 four Hauben, 18/20
what_to_order: Calamari carbonara · Early Bird seating · Prime Time seating
notes: MICHELIN Guide Austria 2026 starred list (ceremony 18 March 2026) and Gault&Millau 2027 Vienna list (page updated 20 Oct 2026); MICHELIN venue page
verdict: A dish a sea-cook can steal from: the carbonara idea built on squid.
caveat: Two fixed seatings on Friday and Saturday; closed Monday, Tuesday and Sunday.

name: aend
what_to_order: Rinderfilet & Seeigel · Reh Wienerwald & Salatherzen · Charcoal-grilled Atlantic turbot · Alte Milchkuh & Sellerie
price_range: Menu PDF: large 240, small 210 per person, wine pairing 145 / 110; 4-course lunch 140
notes: Own site contact page and MICHELIN page
verdict: Two-ingredient courses and a wine listed against every one.
caveat: Closed Saturday and Sunday. Menu PDF is undated; check what is current.

name: Z'SOM
what_to_order: Maitake, Jerusalem artichoke, sake kasu, chontaduro, garapiñado · Meagre, pil pil de tucupi, oca, huacatay
notes: Own site and MICHELIN page
verdict: Latin American pantry, Viennese tasting-menu format.
caveat: Open Wednesday to Sunday evenings only; kitchen's last order 19:30.

name: Plachutta Wollzeile
what_to_order: Tafelspitz · Wiener Schnitzel · Ganslsuppe and Martinigansl
reservation: Reserve on the site or by phone
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31 with hours and a dated 2026 goose announcement
verdict: The place to learn Vienna's beef cuts the way the city eats them.
caveat: Busy and touristed; also at Hietzing (Auhofstraße 1) and Nussdorf (Heiligenstädter Straße 179).
hot_this_month: The Martinigansl season began on 21 October 2026.

name: Figlmüller Wollzeile
what_to_order: Wiener Schnitzel · Zwiebelrostbraten · Kaiserschmarrn · Vegan schnitzel
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31 with current hours
verdict: The schnitzel specialist; start here to compare.

name: Zum Schwarzen Kameel
what_to_order: Schnitzerl · Rindstafelspitz · Aufstriche im Glas · Hand-cut Beinschinken
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31 with current hours
verdict: A delicatessen and brasserie for ham, spreads in a jar and a Viennese lunch.

name: Gasthaus Wild
what_to_order: Stewed calf's lights with bread dumpling · Breaded black pudding with horseradish on potato-cabbage salad · Braised wild boar ragout with bread dumpling · Boiled potato dumpling stuffed with minced meat on red cabbage
price_range: Mains €15.90-26.50 on the 31 Oct 2026 evening menu
notes: Own site and its dated menu PDF
verdict: Habsburg crown-land cooking on a daily-changing card.
caveat: Its own pages disagree on whether Monday is closed.
hot_this_month: Gansl-Zeit runs 6–22 November 2026, after the Wildwochen end on 31 October.

name: Gasthaus Pöschl
what_to_order: Wiener Schnitzel vom Kalb mit Erdäpfelsalat · Gekochter Tafelspitz mit Kürbiskraut & G'röste · Gebackene Fledermaus mit Erdäpfel-Vogerlsalat · Kaiserschmarrn mit Marillenröster

notes: Own site gasthauspoeschl.at shows address, hours and a lunch menu dated 01.11.2026-05.11.2026.
verdict: A plain, in-town place to eat Viennese home cooking by the book, at lunch for the price of a sandwich elsewhere.
caveat: The site gives no history and names no chef; the lunch plates are sold only until 16:00 or while stocks last.

name: Gmoakeller
what_to_order: Rindsuppe with Fleischstrudel · Jungschweinsbraten with Sauerkraut and Serviettenknödel · Schinkenfleckerl with Bummerlsalat · Gebackener Kabeljau with Mayonnaisesalat
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31 with a dated lunch menu for 26-30 Oct 2026
verdict: A good lunch counter for the whole classic repertoire at office-worker prices.
caveat: On the Heumarkt next to the Stadtpark; lunch menus can sell out.

name: Umar
address: Naschmarkt 38-39, 1060 Wien (wien.info; the site gives a different stand number)
what_to_order: Tuna tartare · Oysters Fin de Claire N°2 · Prawns in clay pot · Octopus salad
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31 with the winter hours note
verdict: The fish counter for a sea cook in a landlocked city.
caveat: The site says it is closed on Sunday and holidays in the winter months; the stand number differs between sources.

name: Zur Eisernen Zeit
what_to_order: Wochenspezialitäten · Saisonale Spezialitäten
notes: Own site, copyright 2026, loads 2026-10-31 with hours
verdict: A beisl lunch between market stalls.
caveat: Individual dishes not checked; look at the weekly specials page before going. Sunday closes at 17:00.

name: Hansen
what_to_order: Egg dishes · Breakfast classics · Waldviertler Weidegans
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31 with a dated goose-season menu
verdict: A weekday business breakfast in a historic hall.
caveat: Hours not checked.

name: Do-An
what_to_order: Stuffed falafel · Grilled calamari · Breakfast until 14:00
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31
verdict: A market breakfast or a late falafel.

name: Orient & Occident
what_to_order: Mama's hummus · Turkish home cooking · Mezze and grill · Breakfast
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31
verdict: Turkish home cooking in the middle of the market.

name: Mochi

notes: mochi.at: banner announcing Sunday opening from 8 November and a current menu PDF listing 2025 vintages.

caveat: Not a traditional Japanese kitchen: the site itself says it blends Japanese cooking with European and international influences. Closed Sundays on the Praterstraße page.

name: Café C.I. — Club International
what_to_order: Café food and drinks · Association café
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31
verdict: A meeting-point café with a social mission, on the market square.
caveat: Menu not checked.

name: Demel
what_to_order: Demel's Sachertorte · Kaiserschmarrn · Torten, Pralinen
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31
verdict: Vienna's other Sachertorte, the one that lost the name 'Original'.
caveat: No reservations are possible.

name: Café Sacher Wien
what_to_order: Original Sachertorte · Sacher in the box
notes: Hotel site loads 2026-10-31; wien.info page
verdict: The recipe is secret; about a third of 360,000 tortes a year are eaten on the premises.
caveat: Price and hours not checked against a source.

name: Gerstner
what_to_order: Sonntagsbrunch · Konditorei and chocolatier · Opera and Musikverein catering
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31
verdict: Confectionery with a court pedigree, near the opera.
caveat: Addresses and hours were not checked.

name: Gasthaus Birner
address: Obere Alte Donau 47, 1210 Wien (as printed in Falter 2019)
what_to_order: Karpfen wie gewachsen, gebacken or serbisch gebraten · Zanderfilet serbisch gebraten · Fischbeuschelsuppe
notes: Weekly lunch plan 26-30 October 2026 on its own site; opening-hours page edited 2026-02-14.
verdict: The Viennese carp where Viennese carp belongs, near water.
caveat: The new website is under construction (the www.gasthaus-birner.at address shows a maintenance page); the working legacy site is gasthausbirner.at. The Speisekarte file is named 2025 but its PDF was created 9 May 2026. Address is from Falter 2019; not re-read from the venue.

name: Motto am Fluss
what_to_order: Zanderfilet · Gebeizte Lachsforelle
notes: Own site shows current hours and links menu PDFs created 28 and 30 September 2026.
verdict: The most polished place to eat a Zander with the Donaukanal moving past.
caveat: The Zander comes with vongole, a modern plate rather than a traditional Viennese one. Kitchen times differ: the website says kitchen to 22:00 (café) and to 23:00 (restaurant), the menu PDF says Mon-Sat to 23:00, Sun to 22:30. Farm or river origin of the Zander is not stated.

name: Das Bootshaus
address: An der unteren Alten Donau 61, 1220 Wien
what_to_order: Fish & Chips · Moules frites · Bootshaus Gansl
notes: Own site shows winter programme, 'Ganslzeit ab 15. Oktober' and current hours.
verdict: Best for a quiet lunch or goose season by the lake after the sailing season.
caveat: Run by the Querfeld group; menu pages not individually read beyond the homepage dishes. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

name: Bitzinger Würstelstand — Albertina
what_to_order: Käsekrainer · Bosna · Sacherwürstl · Champagne
notes: wien.info listing and News interview updated 6 Feb 2026
verdict: The stand to take a non-Viennese colleague to.

name: Zum Scharfen Rene
neighborhood: A Würstelstand; the stand's own location was not given
what_to_order: Hot chilli blends · Homemade curry sauce · Würstel with own spice mixes
notes: Shop site loads 2026-10-31 with current Billa-listing notice; wien.info describes the stand
verdict: The stand for a cook who wants heat and a very good curry sauce.
caveat: The stand's own location and hours were not checked; the shop site is a separate business arm.

name: Alles Wurscht
what_to_order: Bosna · Beef tartare · Calamari fritti
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31 and offers catering; stand location from ganz-wien.at
verdict: The stand that shows how far the Würstelstand has stretched.
caveat: Opening hours not checked.

name: Trześniewski
what_to_order: Egg and bacon · Vegan, egg-free spreads · Pfiff of beer
notes: Own site lists branches 2026-10-31
verdict: The fastest proper lunch in the old town.
caveat: A Kafka link is often repeated; no source was found for it.

name: Café Sperl
what_to_order: Melange · Sperl Torte
notes: Own site with hours and the July/August Sunday closure notice; Vienna Tourist Board page lists the same hours.
verdict: The most unspoiled Kaffeehaus on the list: come mid-afternoon on a weekday, order a Melange and stay.
caveat: Closed on Sundays in July and August.

name: Café Hawelka
what_to_order: Buchteln · Melange
notes: Own site with hours and phone; Vienna Tourist Board lists Sunday as 10:00-20:00, so check the Sunday hours.
verdict: Go late: it stays open to midnight or 01:00 and the room feels most like itself after dark.
caveat: The Hawelka roastery shop at Dorotheergasse 7 is temporarily closed for renovation.

name: Café Korb
what_to_order: Wiener Schnitzel · Breakfast all day
notes: Own site with an events list for 5-12 November 2026.
verdict: The best of the old houses for an evening with something on: music, philosophy cafe, readings.
caveat: Closed Sundays. The site header carries an unrendered placeholder, so the welcome-text hours were used.
hot_this_month: Concerts and readings in the Art Lounge through November.

name: Jonas Reindl Coffee Roasters — Westbahnstraße
what_to_order: House espresso · Filter
notes: Own site listing four open cafes and the Westbahnstraße roastery.
verdict: The reference third-wave stop; sit in the roastery cafe, not the Schottentor one.
caveat: Its site carries no update date, so hours are as listed, not independently confirmed.

name: Coffee Pirates
what_to_order: Homemade pastries · Beans from the Vienna roastery
notes: Own site: footer 2026, visit page with addresses and hours.
verdict: The roastery to visit when you want the farm-price story behind the cup, in a room that borrows from the Kaffeehaus.
caveat: Bakery (Spitalgasse 15) is Mon-Fri 09:00-16:00 and closed on Saturdays and public holidays. No phone number on the site; email office@coffeepirates.at.

name: Kaffemodul
what_to_order: Espresso · Filter coffee · Beans and brewing gear
notes: Own site: footer "Copyright 2014-2026", hours and phone.
verdict: Order the espresso or the filter and take beans home; the founders also run workshops by email request.
caveat: Closed Sunday; the space is tiny by its own account.

name: Mayer am Pfarrplatz
what_to_order: Mayers Gansl · Mayers Gratinierter Ziegenkäse · Mayers Geröstete Knödel · Mayers Topfenschmarren
notes: Own site loads 2026-10-31 with hours and an Instagram post dated 29 Oct
verdict: Eat goose where Beethoven lodged.
caveat: No prices on the site; buffet contents are described generally.
hot_this_month: The goose menu (Mayers Gansl) is on in the autumn season.

name: Weingut Feuerwehr-Wagner
what_to_order: Gansleinmachsuppe with Bröselknödel · Quarter goose with Serviettenknödel · Kalbsschnitzel · Eismarillenknödel
notes: Own site said open today 16:00-24:00 on 2026-10-31 and posts the current menu
verdict: A real wine-tavern kitchen with full dishes, not only a buffet.
caveat: Seasonal hours; check the site before going. Quarter goose needs pre-ordering.

name: Heuriger Wieninger
recognition: Falstaff Heurigen Guide: 95 points, 4 grapes (per own site)
what_to_order: Gansl menu · Quarter goose
notes: Own site with Gansl dates and prices for 2026.
verdict: The most polished of the Stammersdorf Heurigen; book in Gansl season.
caveat: Open only Saturday and Sunday/holidays. The family's Buschenschank am Nussberg (Eichelhofweg 125, 1190 Wien; Thu 14:00-22:00, Fri-Sat 12:00-22:00, Sun 11:00-22:00; +43 1 320 06 43) reopened on 2 April 2026 and states no closing date, so call before a November trip.
hot_this_month: Gansl-Zeit to 29 November 2026: the three-course goose menu is €45.

name: 10er Marie
what_to_order: Gans'l essen · House wine
notes: Own site with 2026 goose dates.
verdict: The Heuriger you can reach by city transport; the Gans'l is the seasonal order.
caveat: Advance reservations are requested for the goose.

name: Salm Bräu
what_to_order: Unfiltered house beer · Spirits distilled from its beers · Martinigansl
notes: Own site with hours and a copyright 2026 footer.
verdict: The Vienna brewpub for house beer and a Brennerei under one roof.
caveat: Brewery tours by arrangement only; evening tours are rarely possible. The spirits list was not on the pages checked, so ask what is poured.
hot_this_month: Martinigansl is on the autumn card.

name: Siebensternbräu
what_to_order: Helles NZ style · Imperial IPA
notes: Own site with hours, taps and the Bier Guide 2026 mark.
verdict: The Vienna brewpub for a plate and a tank beer, with the leafy beer garden.
caveat: Kitchen closes an hour before the room.

name: Ottakringer Brauerei
what_to_order: Brewery tour · Bio-Zwickl Rot 5 L keg
notes: Own site listing events in October and November 2026.
verdict: Book the brewery tour on its site rather than counting on a walk-in.
caveat: The tour price and times were not shown on the page checked.
hot_this_month: A Disko Theke in the old plant hall on 6 November 2026 at 20:00, from 16.

name: Heunisch & Erben
recognition: Falstaff Bar Guide 2026: 97; Restaurant & Inn Guide 2026: 94
what_to_order: Wines by the glass · Natural wine
notes: Falstaff Bar Guide 2026 and Restaurant & Inn Guide 2026 listings; no own site found to read.
verdict: The grown-up natural-wine bar: eat at the bar and let them pour by the glass.
caveat: Sources disagree on opening hours (17:00 vs 15:00 start, Tue-Sat); confirm by phone.

name: Pub Klemo
what_to_order: Weekly themed flights · Open-wine list · Shop wine at the bar
notes: Own site (pubklemo.com, redirected from pubklemo.at) with tasting dates 27 Oct to 5 Dec 2026.
verdict: Go for a themed flight or a bottle from the shop opened at the bar.
caveat: No food menu on the pages checked; the site lists a general number for the shops, not the bar.
hot_this_month: Two flights in November: 2–7 November (a white Burgundy, €38) and 9–14 November (Syrah, Burgenland against the Rhône, €34).

name: Vinifero Weinbar
what_to_order: Thursday tasting · Friday Vinothek tasting · Wine and dine pop-ups
notes: Own site with news items for tastings on 15, 22 and 29 October.
verdict: Good for bottles you will not see elsewhere in Vienna; the Thursday tasting is the easy way in.
caveat: Closed Sunday and Monday; the home page news lists tastings on 15, 22 and 29 October.

name: Loos American Bar
what_to_order: Classic cocktails · The room
notes: Own site with dress code and hours.
verdict: Architecture first, cocktail second: go early before the room fills.
caveat: Dress code: no flip-flops, backpacks or shorts.

name: Truth & Dare
what_to_order: Mini of the Week · Classic cocktails with a twist
notes: Own site; Falstaff Bar Guide 2026 listing.
verdict: The right place for a serious cocktail without a hotel-bar bill.
caveat: The site's summer section appears to use 2022 assets, so check the second location's hours.

name: Sacher Blue Bar
recognition: The 50 Best Hotels 2026: No. 42 (per hotel site)
what_to_order: Cocktails · The after-Opera drink
notes: Own site shows the Blue Bar hours and the 2026 ranking.
verdict: The after-Opera drink on the same street as the Opera.
caveat: Hotel prices; hours as listed.

name: Shh. Listening Bar
what_to_order: Highballs · Rare whiskies · Aperitif and spritz variations
notes: Organiser sabroso.at lists a Soul Sabroso DJ session at Shh., Wiedner Hauptstraße 18, on 24 Oct 2026; no own site exists to read.
verdict: Silent focus on the record: the thin Vienna scene has one real example.
caveat: No own website (Instagram only); cash only per Falter; hours are from an undated Falter listing.

name: Jazzland
what_to_order: Live jazz · The cellar under the Ruprechtskirche
notes: Own site with the 31 October event.
verdict: Walk-in only: the site says reservations are not accepted.
caveat: Ticket prices not on the page checked.

name: Porgy & Bess
what_to_order: The jazz cellar · Cult acts
notes: Own site with events on 31 October 2026.
verdict: Check the programme: it also runs Tim Curry nights and cult acts, not only jazz.
caveat: Ticket prices not checked.

name: Wiener Staatsoper — standing room
what_to_order: A standing place · The subtitle screen
reservation: Standing is sold on the day only, online
notes: Own site: ticket-info page, home page listing performances through 12 November 2026.
verdict: Buy at 10:00 on the day; the per-area prices are not on the page, so check the shop before you queue.
caveat: The earlier figures (€18/13/15 and "80 minutes before curtain") came from search summaries and are removed; the official page does not state them. The page does not explain the BT-Card.

name: Konzerthaus
what_to_order: Wiener Symphoniker · A non-classical night
notes: Own site listing dated events through 1 Dec 2026.
verdict: More varied than the Musikverein: a good choice for a non-classical night.
caveat: Standing rules not on the pages checked.
hot_this_month: On the November bill: Pygmalion on 6 November, Mnozil Brass on 15 November.

name: Flex
what_to_order: Club night · A live show
notes: Own site listing events to 28 Nov 2026.
verdict: A safe pick for a live show or club night: check the calendar.
caveat: Tourist-board hours come from an archived page.

name: Flucc

what_to_order: Wanne and Deck · A free early show
notes: Own site with events through 22 Nov 2026 and beyond.
verdict: The one for the scene rather than the tourists.

name: Domäne Wachau

notes: Own site lists winter-season hours and 2025 and 2024 vintage prices, fetched 31 Oct 2026
verdict: The most efficient single stop for learning the Wachau ladder in one hour.
caveat: Tasting and tour prices are not published on the page; ask by email. Closed on public holidays.

name: Weingut Kracher

notes: Own site states the 15 Nov-31 Mar winter rule and current hours, fetched 31 Oct 2026
verdict: Book the large tasting if you want the sweet-wine range, not just the dry reds.
caveat: Tasting prices and length are not published; the form takes requests only. From 15 Nov to 31 Mar weekend tastings are by appointment only.
